payload.caption: Overhead view of an urban site featuring a central compound with circular drive patterns and surrounding residential structures.
payload.description: Overhead optical imagery displaying a large, bounded open facility situated within an urban residential environment. The central feature is a large circular road and pad layout containing multiple curved radial bays/revetments arranged symmetrically around a central axis. To the south of this circular network lie several low-rise rectangular structures, paved aprons, and parked lines of small vehicles or equipment. The surrounding area consists of a dense urban road grid, multi-story apartment blocks, construction/earthwork areas, and a red oval running track immediately west of the facility boundary.

features.note: Large circular perimeter drive containing multiple curved internal bays and radiating access roads around a central spine.
Multiple low-rise rectangular buildings positioned south of the circular pad area.
Rows of small rectangular objects parked along paved hardstands south of the circular track.
Red oval sports track with green infield located outside the west perimeter of the compound.

payload.gsd_note: Resolution is sufficient to distinguish broad facility geometry, road layouts, building footprints, and vehicle groupings.
